name: ListCheck — API on RapidAPI
description:
Screen a whole contact list in one call: ListCheck checks emails, phone numbers and card numbers together and returns a per-item verdict for every row, so CRM imports, signup exports and lead lists can be cleaned before they reach your systems.

What you get:
- One batch call for mixed lists: email syntax and domain-level validation, phone numbering-plan validation with country and E.164 format, card format and Luhn checks
- A structured verdict per item plus a batch summary, ready to feed back into your import pipeline
- Honest scope: email checks are domain-level (syntax, MX, disposable domains) and do not probe individual mailboxes; phone checks validate the numbering plan, not live reachability

Key endpoints:
- POST /screen/batch — screen up to 100 items per leg in one call
- POST /screen/single — screen one item

Plans: BASIC is free with 200 calls per month. PRO is $9/month for 10,000 calls. ULTRA is $29/month for 50,000 calls plus $0.001 per additional call.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
